answers.workaround:
```gdscript
static func variant_to_vector2(variant: Variant) -> Vector2:
	if typeof(variant) == TYPE_VECTOR2:
		# shortcut
		@warning_ignore("unsafe_cast")
		return variant as Vector2
	
	var v: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
	
	if typeof(variant) != TYPE_STRING:
		push_error("Couldn't parse variant type to Vector2 because it's not a string. Type: ", typeof(variant))
		return v
	
	@warning_ignore("unsafe_cast")
	var s: String = variant as String
	
	if not s.begins_with("(") or not s.ends_with(")") or not s.contains(","):
		push_error("Couldn't parse variant to Vector2 because string format is unrecognized. Value: ", s)
		return v
	
	s = s.substr(1, s.length() - 2)
	
	v.x = float(s.get_slice(",", 0))
	v.y = float(s.get_slice(",", 1))
	
	return v
```
